meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用 Centinela(QA)助手做代码安全审计:检查登录/权限,扫描硬编码密钥和依赖漏洞,并对照 OWASP Top 10 排查;含 Solidity 合约也审查。最后把“通过/需修改”结论写入 docs/reviews 报告,交给开发助手。
howto.when: 当你输入 /security-audit(可带目录)时触发;典型场景有发版前、改动登录/权限代码后、引入新依赖等。未指定范围时审计整个 src/。

say.text: 发版前,我想跑一次 /security-audit,检查整个项目。
say.note: 未给路径时,默认审计整个 src/ 目录。

say.text: 我刚加了新依赖,请执行一次 security-audit,看有没有已知漏洞。
say.note: 会检查依赖漏洞,并给“通过/需修改”结论。

howto.what_en: Claude calls Centinela to audit auth/permissions, secrets, and dependencies; reviews OWASP Top 10; checks Solidity contracts if present. Writes APPROVED/CHANGES REQUIRED report to docs/reviews and hands findings to Dev agent.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /security-audit (optionally with a path). Typical cases: pre-release, after auth/permission changes, or after adding dependencies. With no path, it audits the whole src/ directory.

say_en.text: Please use security-audit to check the src/auth/ directory.
say_en.note: The audit focuses on that directory and produces a report.

say_en.text: Before release, run a security audit over the whole project.
say_en.note: With no path, it will audit the entire src/ directory.

say_en.text: I just added new dependencies; run security-audit for known issues.
